records.title: NCETM — Non-unit fractions: identifying, representing and comparing
records.retrieval: Official HTML introduction and teaching points1–8, not full guide/video.
records.use: Reason from common unit size and the number of units before comparing numerators; include equality and the whole boundary.
records.ageAdaptation: English Year3 teacher guidance adapted to frozen Finnish grades3–6. Same-numerator comparison and addition are outside this atomic goal.
records.licence: NCETM default Crown/OGL with acknowledgement and named-author/third-party exceptions; concept comparison only, original Finnish prose/SVG planned.

familyMapping.pick: Choose larger like-denominator fraction; inherited common-unit reasoning is controlled with same-whole models.
familyMapping.symbol: All comparison directions and equality explicitly shown; symbol reading is supported, not a separate entry gate.
familyMapping.order: Order three fractions; optional connection to interval construction, no claim of full list sorting skill.
familyMapping.half: Sort relative to suppliedhalf; optional supplied4/8 benchmark, not an added equivalence prerequisite.
familyMapping.transfer: Strictly-between choice; authored constructive task accepts3/8 and4/8 and all equivalent part arrangements in the fixedpartition.

demoInventory.say: Molemmat levyt on leikattu kahdeksaan palaan. Otetaan paloja rinnakkain: kumpi saa enemmän?
Kun nimittäjä on sama, palat ovat samankokoisia. Silloin riittää verrata osoittajia.
Yhtä monta samankokoista palaa on yhtä paljon.

corrections: Explicit same whole and unit before denominator shortcut; fraction value distinguished from physical amount when wholes differ.
Correct both directions and equality; allvalid construction counts/locations accepted, original equalwhole size exact.
Model/help and count-preserving rearrangement preserve fixed practice verdict; task/part edits invalidate.

planning.concreteToRepresentation: Paper/unit grouping or equal-whole comparison → original diagram → controllable meaningful action → vocabulary/symbols → short checked construction and transfer.

interaction.action: Separate two-count common-unit exploration; any valid constructive shading in a strict interval/equality including named set transfer; truth-preserving rearrangement.
interaction.feedback: Current visible response checked; component-local both-event invalidation; invariant independent model/help preserves verdict.

planning.optionalHelp: Short help details, advanced exploration, teacher/offline directions and exit question in body.
limits: Small nonnegative counts within one named whole; like denominators only.
No unlike-denominator ordering algorithm, arithmetic, physical partition skill or independent free explanation demonstrated.
Construction fields use buttons; task selector has both input/change semantics, explicit check reads current target and visible selections.
planning.evidenceLimit: Supported local practice only; no independent/delayed/formal mastery, human/learner validation, persistence or efficacy claim.
